name: Deal transfer between books
definition: Identifying deals to move, kill or terminate and moving them to another book, such as the bankruptcy books, and reconciling the lists of deals moved.

synthesis.description: Risk and logistics staff spot deals sitting in the wrong book, or deals that must be killed or terminated, and send lists asking the book owner to flip them, often right away or by the next day. In the bankruptcy period, termination lists and contract lists arrive repeatedly, deals are moved into the bankruptcy books, stragglers follow, some deals are moved back to live books, and the risk side cross-references the final list against its calculations.
steps: Identify deals that sit in the wrong book or must be killed or terminated.
Compile a list or spreadsheet of deal numbers with source and target books.
Send the list to the book owner or risk group asking for the move.
Flip the deals in the trading system and confirm they have been moved.
Handle follow-up lists of stragglers and any reversals back to live books.
Reconcile the final list of moved deals against risk calculations and transfer numbers.
stalls: Risk waits on a final list of terminated deals to cross-reference while more straggler lists keep arriving.
Confusion about a specific deal requires a phone call, and a question about who changes the counterparty on a sale shows unclear handling.
A proposed index book waits on a reply, and a reporting system fails to print.
contradictions: Ownership of terminations and estate risk is named differently: one sender says she and Darron will handle terminations from now on, while another says Greg Couch will lead the estate risk effort.
Deals are sent to be moved into the bankruptcy books, then the same requester asks for transactions to be moved from the bankruptcy book back to the live side.
synthesis.approach: Use one standard deal-move request sheet (deal number, source book, target book, trader, reason) and a daily report that matches termination lists against current book assignments, flagging deals not yet moved and any reversals.
synthesis.rationale: Requests arrive as ad hoc lists in many formats and are repeatedly followed by stragglers; a single layout and an automated match against the master termination list cut rework and make reconciliation straightforward.

estimate.label: estimate, not a count
estimate.rationale: Building the deal list, looking up each deal's current book, flipping the deals in the system and checking the result against termination lists or transfer numbers. Many rounds cover a few deals; bankruptcy rounds cover longer lists and reconciliation, hence the high end.
